plan.rationale: Initial plan: no prior evaluations, so all allowed tile and stage values are included, threads fixed at 128, and swizzle restricted to [0] to establish a conventional row-major baseline per instructions. M=N=K=2048 is divisible by all listed block_M (32/64/128), block_N (64/128), and block_K (32/64), so the divide constraint is nonbinding. Shared-memory cap is set to the hard 32768-byte portability limit; the estimator max(2*block_K*(block_M+block_N)*num_stages, 4*block_M*block_N) plus compiler aliasing will be filtered naturally by HiGHS's byte constraint, with compiled memory still checked later. Equal unit weights keep traffic, launch count, pipeline depth, and footprint balanced for an unbiased first comparison. The analytic reuse term is treated as a hypothesis only; after feedback I will inspect simulator traffic/latency, broaden swizzle to [0,4,8,16] if locality gains appear or if exclusions narrow the feasible set, and retune weights/domains based on numerical checks, SMT/compile results, and simulator estimates. Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR; CUDA binary execution is not validated, and GB10 latencies are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements. This is exploratory, not a claim of global optimality.

Attempt-00 passed numerical checks, compiled, and simulated at 234.82 us with block_M=128, block_N=64, block_K=64, num_stages=1, swizzle=0; actual smem hit exactly 32768 bytes with 122 registers and 3 blocks/SM. Only one point exists, so exclusion is minimal and no domain widening is needed. Since the baseline row-major point is already evaluated, I now open swizzle to [0,4,8,16] to test the serpentine-panel locality hypothesis, keeping allowed M/N/K tiles (M=N=K=2048 divisible by all). Cap stays at the hard 32768 portability limit; large tile/stage combinations exceeding the estimator will be filtered by HiGHS's byte constraint, with compiled smem still checked. Weights shift modestly: raise traffic to 1.5 to probe whether swizzle-driven reuse reduces simulated DRAM traffic, lower footprint to 0.75 since attempt-00 already saturates the cap and heavy footprint pressure could bias away from good pipelines, and keep launches/pipeline at 1 to avoid overfitting to a single sample. The panel reuse feature remains an analytic hypothesis; I will compare simulated DRAM/latency across swizzle values before trusting it. Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR; CUDA binary is not executed, and GB10 values are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements. This is exploratory and not a claim of global optimality.

Two evaluated points: attempt-00 (128x64x64, stages=1, swizzle=0) at 234.82 us and attempt-01 (64x128x64, stages=1, swizzle=16) at 235.12 us. Both compiled, passed numerical checks, and used exactly 32768 smem with 3 blocks/SM. Simulated DRAM was identical at 16.78 MB for both, so opening swizzle to [0,4,8,16] produced no locality gain and no latency improvement — the analytic panel-reuse feature did not materialize in simulator traffic. I therefore reduce traffic weight from 1.5 back toward 0.75 (since DRAM did not differentiate) and raise pipeline to 1.25 to push HiGHS toward larger block_K or num_stages>1, which the two stage=1 samples have not yet explored; footprint stays at 1 because both samples saturate the cap and the actual 32768 result matches the estimator. Keep the hard 32768 portability cap, keep threads fixed at 128, keep full tile and stage domains since M=N=K=2048 is divisible by all and exclusion so far only removes two points. Swizzle remains [0,4,8,16] to continue probing the hypothesis alongside deeper pipelines; if stage>1 selections repeatedly fail SMT/compile or show no gain, I will reconsider. Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR; CUDA binary execution is not validated, and GB10 values are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements. This is exploratory, not a claim of global optimality.

Three evaluated points: attempt-00 (128x64x64, stages=1, swizzle=0) at 234.82 us, attempt-01 (64x128x64, stages=1, swizzle=16) at 235.12 us, and attempt-02 (64x128x32, stages=2, swizzle=16) at 221.79 us, the new best. All compiled, passed numerical checks, and used exactly 32768 smem with 3 blocks/SM; simulated DRAM was identical at 16.78 MB in every case, so the serpentine swizzle/small-tile locality hypothesis shows no traffic benefit in the simulator. The clear improvement came from num_stages=2, not from swizzle or traffic reduction. Accordingly I raise the pipeline weight from 1.25 to 1.5 to push HiGHS toward larger block_K and stages>1 (the stage=1 and block_K=32 points are now sampled; stages=3 with block_K=64 remains unexplored), keep traffic low at 0.75 since DRAM did not differentiate, keep launches and footprint at 1 (footprint is saturated at the cap and matches the estimator), keep the hard 32768 portability cap, keep threads fixed at 128, and keep full tile/stage/swizzle domains since M=N=K=2048 is divisible by all and exclusion so far removes only three points. Swizzle stays [0,4,8,16] to keep probing it alongside deeper pipelines, but it is deprioritized by the traffic weight. Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR; CUDA binary execution is not validated, and GB10 values are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements. This remains exploratory, not a claim of global optimality.

Four evaluated points, all passed numerics, compiled, and used exactly 32768 smem with 3 blocks/SM and identical 16.78 MB simulated DRAM. Latencies: 128x64x64/s1/sw0=234.82; 64x128x64/s1/sw16=235.12; 64x128x32/s2/sw16=221.79 (best); 64x128x64/s1/sw8=214.47 (new best). Two key observations: (1) swizzle and DRAM traffic never differentiated, so the analytic panel-reuse feature is not materializing in simulator traffic — traffic weight is lowered further to 0.5 and swizzle kept open only for continued probing; (2) improvements came despite higher proxy costs from stage/scheduling changes rather than traffic, and stages=1 with block_N=128 still yielded the best latency, so the pipeline proxy is not tracking latency monotonically. I raise pipeline weight to 2 to steer toward the still-unexplored num_stages=3 regime (all samples so far are s1 or s2), keep launches modest at 0.75 to favor fewer/larger tiles (128-block_M not yet sampled), and hold footprint at 1 since every point saturates the 32768 cap so it cannot differentiate. block_N is narrowed to [128] because both 64- and 128-N samples exist and 128-N holds the best latency; block_M [64,128] keeps the unsampled 128 path available while dropping the 32 width; block_K stays [32,64] and num_stages [2,3] to concentrate exploration on deeper-pipeline variants that already excluded s1 best points but leave s2/s3 open. Hard 32768 cap retained. Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR; CUDA binary execution is not validated, and GB10 latency values are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements. This is exploratory and not a claim of global optimality.

Five evaluated points, all numerically passed, compiled, and saturating 32768 smem with 3 blocks/SM and identical 16.78 MB simulated DRAM. Latencies improved monotonically overall: 128x64x64/s1/sw0=234.82; 64x128x64/s1/sw16=235.12; 64x128x32/s2/sw16=221.79; 64x128x64/s1/sw8=214.47; 64x128x32/s2/sw8=203.69 (new best). Swizzle and simulated DRAM have never differentiated, so the analytic panel-reuse hypothesis is not materializing in traffic; traffic weight stays low at 0.5 and swizzle is kept open only to continue probing. Best points use block_N=128, so block_N remains narrowed to [128]; block_M stays [64,128] to keep the unsampled 128-M row alive; block_K [32,64] and stages [2,3] concentrate on deeper-pipeline variants since s1 points are all dominated. Pipeline weight held at 2 to keep steering toward the still-unsampled num_stages=3 regime (block_K=64 with s3 is untested), launches at 0.75 to favor larger/fewer tiles, footprint at 1 since every point saturates the cap and cannot differentiate. Hard 32768 portability cap retained. Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR; CUDA binary execution is not validated, and GB10 latency values are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements. Exploratory only; not a claim of global optimality.

Six evaluated points, all numerically passed, compiled, and saturating 32768 smem with 3 blocks/SM and identical 16.78 MB simulated DRAM. Latencies: 128x64x64/s1/sw0=234.82; 64x128x64/s1/sw16=235.12; 64x128x32/s2/sw16=221.79; 64x128x64/s1/sw8=214.47; 64x128x32/s2/sw8=203.69; 64x128x32/s2/sw4=203.69 (tied best). Swizzle values 4 and 8 gave identical latency and no DRAM change, confirming the analytic panel-reuse feature still is not materializing in simulator traffic; swizzle is kept open only as a probe and traffic weight stays low at 0.5. block_N=[128] and block_M=[64,128] retained (128-M row still unsampled). block_K=[32,64] and stages=[2,3] concentrate on deeper-pipeline variants; s1 points are dominated. Pipeline weight stays 2 to keep pushing toward num_stages=3 with block_K=64, which remains untested. Launches 0.75 favors larger/fewer tiles; footprint 1 is non-differentiating since all points hit the cap. Hard 32768 cap retained for portability. Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR; CUDA binary is not executed, and GB10 latencies are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements. This is exploratory and not a claim of global optimality; the next hypothesis is that num_stages=3 (possibly with block_K=64 or the unsampled block_M=128 row) yields lower simulated latency than the current 203.69 us best.

Seven evaluated points, all numerically passed, compiled, and saturating 32768 smem with 3 blocks/SM and identical 16.78 MB simulated DRAM. Best remains 203.69 us at 64x128x32/s2 with swizzle 8 or 4; swizzle 0 at the same tile/stage gave 222.18 us, and swizzle 4 and 8 were identical, so serpentine locality affects simulator latency only inconsistently and never changes DRAM traffic — the analytic panel-reuse hypothesis is not supported as a traffic benefit. The 128-block_M row and block_K=64 with num_stages=3 remain unsampled. Keep block_N narrowed to [128] (all best points), block_M [64,128], block_K [32,64], stages [2,3] to concentrate on deeper pipelines since all s1 points are dominated. Swizzle kept open [0,4,8,16] as a probe but its weight effect stays low via traffic=0.5. Pipeline raised influence held at 2 to steer toward untested stage=3/block_K=64; launches 0.75 favors fewer/larger tiles; footprint 1 is non-differentiating because every point hits the cap. Hard 32768 portability cap retained. Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR; CUDA binary is not executed, and GB10 latencies are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements. Exploratory only; next hypothesis is that num_stages=3, possibly with block_K=64 or the unsampled block_M=128 row, beats 203.69 us.
